title: Baa Juice Sour Blue Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Sour Blue Raspberry Nic Salt delivers a tangy twist on a classic berry flavour. The Blue Raspberry provides juicy sweetness while the sour note adds extra bite, creating a sharp yet balanced vape. Made as part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is double-concentrated for the punchy taste associated with bar-style vapes. The 50VG/50PG blend is tailored for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring vivid flavour, discreet vapour and a comfortable throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Sour Blue Raspberry is a standout berry mix for refillable vape kits and vape starter kits .
